QuestInfo.name: Mai's Final Training
QuestInfo.0: #b#p11##k's training is just about defeating monsters, but it seems really useful for learning how to hunt. Let's continue with #p11#'s training.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p11##k believes that, while understanding my abilities is important, challenging myself with stronger monsters is also a great training method. She asked me to defeat #r1 #o9##k.
An #r#o9##k...? They seem really strong. Can I really defeat one?
QuestInfo.2: After #b#p11##k's training, I feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! I should go to #b#m60##k and take the boat to Victoria Island.

0.0: Wow, you're fast! That's awesome. We'll head straight to the next quest. It's important to know your limits, but it's also important to test your abilities. Want to try defeating some powerful monsters?

yes.0: This time, you'll be hunting #r#o9##k, which you WON'T find just casually wandering around. You'll have to go into every portal to find them. I want you to defeat #r1#k!
yes.1: Also, I've heard that #b#p12##k is collecting something from the #r#o9#s#k... If you haven't filled #b#p12##k's request yet, you might want to try doing so while you train.

no.0: If it seems too difficult for you, come back after training against easier monsters.

1.0: So you've taken care of the #r#o9##k? Weren't they hard to find? Let's see how strong you have become...

yes.0: Great job! You're now strong enough to hold your own against any monster here. You'll have to start making job decisions once you reach level 10. If you haven't met #p19# from #m1010# yet, you should go see her. She'll give you a lot of information with her challenges. If we meet again someday, let's catch up. Goodbye!

mob.0: I don't think you're quite done yet. Press Q to check the quest.
